hero.title: Building Dignity, Education, and Sustainable Futures
hero.subtitle: Tackling social vulnerability at its roots through comprehensive education, food security, and workforce inclusion for vulnerable families.

pillars.title: Our Four Strategic Pillars
pillars.subtitle: An integrated framework engineered to break the intergenerational cycles of poverty.
pillars.p1_desc: Academic tutoring, digital literacy, and socio-emotional care for youth.
pillars.p2_desc: Wholesome food supply, community agroecological gardens, and meal equity.
pillars.p3_desc: Technical job training, microfinance mentorship, and female financial autonomy.
pillars.p4_desc: Neighborhood leadership development, cooperative efforts, and infrastructure.

impact_preview.title: Auditable and Measurable Impact
impact_preview.subtitle: Every resource deployed is tracked with strict financial governance and public metric evolution.

transparency_preview.title: Active Transparency
transparency_preview.subtitle: Open accountability in full alignment with international and national non-profit audit standards.

volunteer_cta.title: Be the Catalyst for Change
volunteer_cta.subtitle: Dedicate your skills, time, and empathy to create lasting grassroots transformation.
